title: Male Penguins Go 120 Days Without Food in -40 Degrees

scenes.text: Male emperor penguins go 120 days without eating.
Each one balances a single egg on his feet through the Antarctic winter.
The air can hit minus 40, with gusts up to 120 miles an hour.
So they huddle together, swapping places between the cold edge and the warm middle.
Huddling saves them about a third more energy than standing alone.
Four months, no food, one egg.

description:
Male emperor penguins fast for about four months, losing up to 20 kilograms, while keeping an egg warm on their feet.
Huddling saves about a third more energy in high winds.
Could you do it?
first_comment: Would you last a single day in Antarctica's winter?
